lines.en: Wasn't there a time when the brightest minds in the world believed that the Earth was flat?
And up until, like, what, 50 years ago, you all thought the atom was the smallest thing
until you split it open and this, like, whole mess of crap came out.
Now, are you telling me that you are so unbelievably arrogant
that you can't admit that there's a teeny tiny possibility that you could be wrong about this?
There might be a teeny tiny possibility.
You just abandoned your whole belief system.
No, I mean, before, I didn't agree with you, but at least I respected you.
No, how, how, how are you going to go into work tomorrow?
How, how are you going to face the other science guys?
How, how are you going to face yourself?
How, how, how, how, how are you going to face yourself?
